title: Pairwise independent row count
statement: For a nonnegative integer $n$, define the row count to be $\max\{1,\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil\}$, where the ceiling-logarithm denotes the least natural number $r$ such that $2^r\ge n+1$.
